card.name: Verbs before a limit like no more than
card.fires_on: Verbs, prepositions or nouns right before a limit or range on a number, such as 'no wider than', 'by 25%', 'at intervals of', or 'for up to'. It appears in instructions about sizes, dose changes, timing, or temperature.

modes.label: Dose change or timing
modes.description: A word just before the amount or interval allowed for increasing or spacing doses.
modes.example: and generally should<< occur>> at intervals of more than 5 days

modes.label: Safety or setting limit
modes.description: A verb before a maximum size, temperature or time in household or care instructions.
modes.example: The refrigerator should be<< set>> at 4°C (40°F

modes.label: Difference or margin
modes.description: A word before a small margin or amount, such as 'by less than'.
modes.example: differs from being perfectly round<< by>> less than 0.000

card.writes: It promotes the word 'no', suggesting a limit phrase such as 'no more than' or 'no wider than' comes next.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before a limit such as 'no more than' or 'at least', in an instruction.
